In the Tibetan language: A Brief Exposition of the Empowerment. Homage to the glorious <term>Vajrasattva</term> <gloss>the Diamond Being</gloss>.

<term>Suchandra</term> <gloss>the King of Shambhala</gloss> requested:

O Teacher, regarding the seven types of empowerment, and the three types <unclear>...</unclear>

<summary>This page contains the opening lines of the Brief Exposition of the Empowerment, beginning with a salutation to Vajrasattva and a request from King Suchandra to the Buddha regarding the categories of tantric initiation.</summary>
<keywords>Vajrasattva, Suchandra, empowerment, initiation, Kalachakra, Tibetan Buddhism, tantra</keywords>
